castellano.notes: Custom Managed Strategy account with five sleeves: the CIO Equity ETF Core model (catalog D,Q,T), an Eaton Vance Large Cap Value Style Manager SMA (Q,T), a mutual fund, a client-selected bond ETF and individual municipal bonds. TER, QLH and DTLH are all elected. Teaching points from the TEM Guide and term sheets: DTLH supersedes QLH on the CIO ETF sleeve; TER and QLH apply to the SMA, fund and ETF sleeves but never to the individual bonds; and a TEM Style Manager Strategy cannot be added as a sleeve, it needs its own Managed account.

notes.message: DTLH cannot be maintained or elected while TET is active. Route a service-change plan; do not auto-cancel or trade.

outside.why: Individual bond: fixed income securities are excluded
Bond fund: confirm whether QLH covers it

qlh.replacement_note: Harvest proceeds go into a replacement ETF chosen to keep market exposure; after the 30-day wash sale period it is sold and the original securities are bought back if the strategy still holds them.

ter.deferral_note: The TEM Guide restricts sales of short-term lots with sizable gains that go long-term within 31 days or less; the TER Term Sheet says sales may be deferred by as many as 30 days. The term sheets do not define "sizable", so Atlas lists every gain lot in the window.
ter.withdrawal_note: Tax-prioritized withdrawals sell overweight positions first, then the largest percentage losses, using best tax lots. Atlas has no security-level targets, so this shows the loss-first order.

dtlh.note: DTLH thresholds are market-derived and not published, so Atlas shows the positions DTLH watches rather than predicting trades.

source_doc.section: An example of Dynamic Tax Loss Harvesting

example.note: Stated values only: ETF AB worth $1,000 in January falls to $940 in February, meets the threshold and is swapped into CD; CD falls to $900 in April and is swapped back into AB.

dtlh.removal_note: If DTLH is removed, replacement ETFs are sold and reinvested in the strategy, which may realize gains.

considerations.message: IEFA is also held in a spouse's IRA at another firm. The overlays only see this account, so a purchase there within 30 days of a harvest here can disallow the loss. Monitoring across accounts is the client’s responsibility.
If DTLH is removed, all replacement ETFs are sold and reinvested in the strategy, which may realize short- and long-term gains.
QLH harvests subject to a portfolio turnover limit set by the firm; not every eligible loss is harvested (wash sale, restrictions, turnover, size).
